text:
Rina K.: hitting a weird edge during quickstart onboarding: followed the Go sample with a workspace that was provisioned via SCIM. First call returns 403 billing_required and the console billing page shows no button to add a card (just an info message). anyone seen this?
Tom B.: sometimes provisioned orgs skip the interactive onboarding. Can you paste the exact curl / request?
Rina K.: basically the sample request: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" -d '{"model":"rw-mini-1","input":"hello"}'` Response: `{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace 112233 has no payment method"}}`
Lena (devex): yep this is a known gap: SCIM-created orgs often land in onboard_state=provisioned which hides the add-card CTA. We added a temporary internal route to surface the form: `/orgs/112233/billing/add-card?force=true` but only internal admins can use it.
Rina K.: admin used the force link and could add a card. after that the quickstart returned 200. can we add a troubleshooting note to the quickstart readme about SCIM/org provisioning?
Tom B.: infra will add a backfill to flip onboard_state when SCIM payload has initial_admin=true. Also SDK team is going to add a clearer 403 message linking to help center.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-3021: "Backfill SCIM onboard_state for provisioned orgs" assigned to infra-provisioning.
Lena (devex): i'll update the quickstart FAQ with a short section: "If you are SSO/SCIM-provisioned and receive 403 billing_required, ask your org admin to use the force add-card link or contact infra."
Rina K.: thanks, tagging me when the doc is live please. closing the thread.
